title: Amazing app
body: Great job on the app—it’s really well made! One suggestion: could you add Apple Health integration for the workouts parameter, similar to how exercise minutes work? That way, even those of us without an Apple Watch can track our exercise. Also, I noticed the app crashes when adding Active Energy from apple health integration

title: Build habits without guilt or perfection pressure
body: I used to drop habits the second I missed a day  all because of streak pressure. Momentumly flipped that for me
author: Gabriel Zimmermann

title: Could have been so much better
body: The app gives good line graph view of your progress, but it lacks to give you the feeling of achievement for completing the tasks and often the date doesn’t update quickly to today. It is difficult for you to know which days you have missed and which days you have done from a monthly perspective. This app lacks the punch. Uninstalling it after buying the premium version and using it for 20 days.
author: AvinashKunchurkar

title: Beautiful and Unique Habit Tracker
body: Perfect habit tracking app with a lot of potential. Beautiful graphs, stats and little bit of gamification makes things fun. Developer is also very responsive and takes feedbacks very positively. I hope we see dark mode, healthkit integration,apple watch app and iCloud backup/account signup support in future. Just a request to developer, please introduce some more gamification to make habit tracking more motivating and interesting.
